items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: >> Go with Paul Whisenant(?) sometime. He knows.

ctx.x: Did you ever go to the tennis matches? Where do you sit? Do you sit in the middle and turn your head this way, or do you sit at the end and watch the strategy? That's the way to watch a tennis match. Sit up about halfway, and watch what the guy is doing.
Go with Paul Whisenant(?) sometime. He knows.
My wife, Ellie, loves tennis. We go every now and then.
